subject: Charged twice for Pro
body: My card was charged twice for the same annual Pro subscription yesterday. Please check the duplicate payment.

subject: Invoice copy
body: Where can I download an invoice for last month's payment?

subject: Payment still pending
body: I paid three days ago and the payment shows pending, so our account is locked from upgrades.

subject: Unexpected tax
body: Can you explain why sales tax appeared on this month's invoice?

subject: Refund after accidental renewal
body: We accidentally renewed and need to know whether a refund is possible before our finance close tomorrow.

subject: Dashboard will not load
body: Every team member gets a blank screen after signing in. We cannot access any customer records.

subject: CSV export errors
body: Exporting reports returns error 500, but we can still view the report in the browser.

subject: Webhook delivery delay
body: Our webhooks are arriving about 20 minutes late today. Is there an incident?

subject: Mobile app crashes
body: The Android app closes whenever I open Settings. Reinstalling did not help.

subject: Browser support
body: Does the admin portal support Firefox ESR?

subject: Locked out after MFA change
body: My old phone was wiped and I cannot complete MFA to access the company account.

subject: Possible account takeover
body: I received password reset emails I did not request and see an unfamiliar login from another country.

subject: Change account email
body: How can I update the email address for my user profile?

subject: Add a teammate
body: I need to invite a new agent, but the invite button is disabled for me.

subject: Account deletion request
body: Please tell me how to permanently delete my personal workspace.

subject: SAML provisioning
body: Please add SCIM provisioning so our IT team can automatically create and remove users.

subject: Dark mode
body: A dark theme would make night shifts much easier for our support agents.

subject: Audit log export
body: We need an exportable audit log before our compliance review next quarter.

subject: Regional data storage
body: Can you support EU-only data residency for new workspaces?

subject: Bulk ticket assignment
body: Please add bulk assignment; manually assigning hundreds of tickets slows our queue each morning.

subject: Partnership inquiry
body: Our agency would like to discuss a reseller partnership. Who should we contact?

subject: Press request
body: A journalist needs a product screenshot and a spokesperson quote by Friday.

subject: Thank you
body: Your team resolved my issue quickly. No action needed; I just wanted to say thanks.

subject: Suspicious email claiming to be support
body: Someone sent me an email saying they are your support team and asked for a password. Is it legitimate?

subject: Accessibility question
body: Do you have a VPAT or accessibility conformance report available?

subject: Cannot tell if my plan renewed
body: The app says active, but I received a cancellation email. I am not sure which is correct.

subject: Login and outage?
body: I cannot log in, and two coworkers cannot either. Could this be a broader outage?

subject: Need access for departing employee
body: An employee leaves today; we need to transfer their workspace ownership, but are unsure of the process.

subject: Idea for saved replies
body: It would be useful if replies could be saved as team templates. No rush.

subject: Notification behavior
body: I am getting more email notifications than expected. I cannot tell which setting controls them.
